qa_pair.question: Among deliveries returned by the recent view, which tracking number has the latest final event date? Return only the tracking number.
How many active deliveries currently have status code 4? Return only the integer.
Find an active delivery whose carrier display name contains “Express.” Return only its carrier code.
Which recent delivery has the greatest number of cached tracking events? Return only its description.
For the most recently delivered package, return the event location from its final event.
Among active deliveries with an expected timestamp, which is expected first? Return only its tracking number.
Find a delivery that requires extra information and return only that extra-information value.
How many carrier codes in the catalog contain the letters “dpd”? Return only the integer.
Which active delivery has the longest description? Return only the description.
Among recent deliveries with a failed attempt or exception, which has the newest event? Return only its tracking number.
